description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-16 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip 1.2, which repaired links in this skill's references and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the three verbs the description names — create, show, execute — plus archival and the dashboard, including German. Near-misses share roadmap vocabulary and belong elsewhere: authoring the plan's content (roadmap-writing, which this skill's dashboard reference links), a product-level prioritisation (rice-prioritization) and a ticket refinement (refine-ticket). Counterexamples guard 'roadmap' as a public product page and 'execute' as running a script.

queries.q: create roadmap for the billing migration
show roadmap progress — which phases are still open?
execute roadmap step 2.1 and tick it off
this roadmap is finished — archive it and update the dashboard
zeig mir die Roadmap und welche Schritte noch offen sind
rewrite the goal and acceptance criteria of this plan so they are falsifiable
queries.note: authoring the plan's content rather than managing the file's lifecycle → roadmap-writing

queries.q: score these five features by reach, impact, confidence and effort
queries.note: product prioritisation that often feeds a roadmap, but is not one → rice-prioritization

queries.q: refine this Jira ticket before we pull it into the sprint
queries.note: planning work at ticket level → refine-ticket

queries.q: update the public product roadmap page on our marketing site
queries.note: 'roadmap' as a published web page, not a file under agents/roadmaps/
